aboutGame.title: What is Jailbreakgame?
paragraphs: Jailbreakgame is an iconic open-world cops-and-robbers action experience on Roblox created by Badimo. Players dive into a dynamic living city where they can choose their allegiance as law-abiding Police Officers or daring Criminals. Plan high-stakes bank robberies, dodge complex laser defense grids, evade high-speed pursuits, or uphold justice by intercepting heists and arresting wanted fugitives across an expansive sandbox.

Beyond the core pursuit gameplay, Jailbreakgame features an expansive economy with over 100 customizable supercars, helicopters, and specialty vehicles, as well as regular seasonal updates, dynamic robbery rotations, and a dedicated player-driven trading hub. Whether you are grinding millions in cash solo or teaming up with a squad, our wiki provides complete guides, vehicle tier lists, and up-to-date codes.

modules.name: Jailbreakgame Beginner Guide
modules.description: A starter guide covering the core gameplay loop, choosing Criminal or Police roles, escaping prison, earning cash, and understanding the open-world map. This module helps new players quickly learn the most important mechanics and progression paths.

highlights.detail: Spawn in prison cells and sneak through the sewer tunnels or punch electrical boxes to escape.
Locate a free starter vehicle like the Camaro or pickup truck to reach the nearest criminal base.
Acquire firearms and watch dynamic robbery icons to hit open venues like the Bank or Jewelry Store.
Deposit stolen loot at the Volcano or Rising City Criminal Base to bank cash and evade arrest.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to common questions about Jailbreakgame mechanics, progression, and updates.

items.question: What is Jailbreakgame?
items.answer: Jailbreakgame is a free-to-play open-world cops and robbers action game on Roblox created by Badimo. Players choose between escaping prison as criminals to pull off multi-building heists or enlisting as police officers to patrol the city and arrest fugitives.

items.question: How do I redeem promo codes in Jailbreakgame?
items.answer: To redeem codes in Jailbreakgame, locate an in-game ATM terminal at the Bank, Gas Station, or Police Station, interact with the screen, type in an active code, and click Redeem to receive free cash and cosmetics.

items.question: What is the fastest vehicle in Jailbreakgame?
items.answer: The Torpedo and Concept boast the highest top speeds in Jailbreakgame, while the Volt Bike and Roadster offer the best acceleration and handling for daily heist grinding.

items.question: How does the dynamic robbery system work in Jailbreakgame?
items.answer: In Jailbreakgame, up to four major robbery locations can remain open simultaneously. As players complete heists or timers expire, queued venues unlock automatically across the map.

items.question: Can you play Jailbreakgame solo or with friends?
items.answer: Jailbreakgame supports both solo play and team squad gameplay. Solo players can grind cash efficiently, while squads can coordinate multi-passenger helicopter heists and split rewards.
